Title: NAFDAC reforms boost local drug production, attract investors, says DG
Summary: NAFDAC Director-General Prof. Mojisola Adeyeye detailed regulatory reforms aimed at boosting local drug production and attracting investment into the pharmaceutical sector. The agency is focusing on streamlining processes to encourage local manufacturing and reduce import dependency.

Title: Fake agency: Reps uncover 58 accounts, probe N400m deal
Summary: The House of Representatives Ad-Hoc Committee has uncovered 58 bank accounts linked to a fraudulent agency posing as the Presidential Foreign Intervention Promotion Council. The committee is probing a N400 million deal involving these accounts to determine the beneficial owners and the nature of the illicit funds.

Title: OB3 pipeline ready for first gas, AKK hits 95% – NNPC
Summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) announces that the Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) pipeline is ready for first gas and the Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano (AKK) pipeline has reached 95% completion.

Title: Morning recap: States owe N5.3tn debt, INEC fears AI disinformation threat, other top stories
Summary: Reports indicate that Nigerian states have accumulated a total debt of N5.3 trillion, raising concerns as several governors' tenures approach their end. Additionally, INEC has flagged the risk of AI-powered disinformation targeting the 2027 elections.

Title: Uber exits Nigeria, Uganda with ‘immediate effect’ as part of global restructure; shuts down ops mid-rides
Summary: Uber has ceased its operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect as part of a broader global corporate restructuring strategy. The exit was executed abruptly, resulting in the shutdown of services mid-ride for some users.

Title: Refinery owners urge FG to curb fuel imports, back local refineries
Summary: The Crude Oil Refinery Owners Association of Nigeria has called on the Federal Government to curb fuel imports and provide stronger support for domestic refineries to reduce foreign dependence.

Title: Uber quits major African markets
Summary: Uber has ceased its operations in Nigeria and Uganda, ending over a decade of presence in both markets. This represents a significant corporate exit and restructuring of its African footprint.

Title: Security expert, Okere, emerges first Nigerian to join WAD board - Vanguard News
Summary: Security expert Okere has been appointed to the board of WAD, becoming the first Nigerian to do so.

Title: Uber exit sparks mixed reactions in Nigeria’s $450m e-hailing market - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: Uber is reportedly exiting the Nigerian market, which is valued at approximately $450 million. The move has sparked mixed reactions within the e-hailing sector.

Title: Economic activities expand as PMI hits 52.7pts —CBN - Vanguard News
Summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) reports an expansion in economic activities, with the Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) reaching 52.7 points.

Title: FAAN Not Responsible for Uber's Nigeria Exit – MD Kuku - Punch Newspapers
Summary: The Managing Director of the Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria (FAAN), Olumide Kuku, has denied that FAAN is responsible for Uber's exit from the Nigerian market.

Title: Oyetola transfers inland dry ports’ functions to NPA - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: Minister Oyetola has transferred the functions and oversight of inland dry ports to the Nigerian Ports Authority (NPA), marking a shift in regulatory and operational control.

Title: OB3 Completion as NNPC Limited Opens a New Chapter for Nigeria’s Gas Economy - Vanguard News
Summary: NNPC Limited has completed the OB3 gas pipeline project, aiming to enhance Nigeria's gas economy and energy infrastructure.

Title: NNPC profit drops as revenue slips by 29.6% in July - Vanguard News
Summary: The NNPC reported a decrease in profit for July, attributed to a 29.6% decline in revenue.

Title: NNPC remits N7.913tr to FAAC amid concerns about OB3 pipeline operations - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) has remitted N7.913 trillion to the Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC). The report also notes ongoing concerns regarding the operations of the OB3 pipeline.

Title: Why Uber left Nigeria – FAAN - Vanguard News
Summary: The Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria (FAAN) has provided insights into the reasons behind Uber's exit from the Nigerian market.

Title: Fake agencies, bloated govt: Why Nigeria still needs Oronsaye Report - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The article discusses the ongoing need for the implementation of the Oronsaye Report, which focuses on restructuring the Nigerian government to eliminate duplicate agencies and reduce bureaucratic bloat.

Title: Sanwo-Olu appoints Gbaye LASBCA General Manager - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: Governor Sanwo-Olu has appointed Mr. Gbaye as the General Manager of the Lagos State Building Control Agency (LASBCA).

Title: AUATON seeks policy support for e-hailers - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The Amalgamated Union of App-based Transport Workers Network (AUATON) is requesting policy support and regulatory framework improvements for e-hailing operators.

Title: Again, NANTA kicks against dollar, city ticket sales by foreign airlines - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The National Association of Nigeria Travel Agents (NANTA) is protesting the practice of foreign airlines selling flight tickets in US Dollars and utilizing city-specific ticket sales.

Title: FG begins tricycle ambulance distribution to strengthen emergency care - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The Federal Government has commenced the distribution of tricycle ambulances to enhance emergency healthcare services across the country.

Title: Amid N300b loss, NDPHC targets solar, mini-hydro in North - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The Niger Delta Power Holding Company (NDPHC) reports a loss of N300 billion and is shifting strategic focus toward solar and mini-hydro power projects in Northern Nigeria.

Title: FG unveils national environmental regulations framework 2026 - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The Federal Government of Nigeria has unveiled the National Environmental Regulations Framework 2026, establishing a new regulatory structure for environmental oversight.

Title: Energy firms invest $4million for expansion of solar mini-grids in Nigerian states - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: Energy firms have invested $4 million to expand solar mini-grids across various Nigerian states to improve energy access.

Title: NEMA, OGSEMA Deepen Collaboration on Disaster Response in Ogun - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) and the Ogun State Emergency Management Agency (OGSEMA) are strengthening their collaboration to improve disaster response efforts within Ogun State.

Title: N750m dispute: Kudiwave protests at PalmPay office, demands return of funds - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: Kudiwave has staged a protest at the offices of PalmPay over a financial dispute involving the demand for the return of N750 million.

Title: BPP moves to automate procurement, curb abuses - The Guardian Nigeria News
Summary: The Bureau of Public Procurement (BPP) is initiating the automation of procurement processes to increase transparency and reduce abuses within the public procurement system.

Title: Uber Exit: Nigeria now ‘graveyard of businesses’ — ADC | - theeagleonline.com.ng
Summary: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has commented on Uber's exit from the Nigerian market, describing the country as a 'graveyard of businesses'. The event highlights the operational withdrawal of a major multinational ride-hailing entity from the region.

Title: Union condemns Uber’s exit from Nigeria | - theeagleonline.com.ng
Summary: Uber is reportedly exiting the Nigerian market, a move that has drawn condemnation from union representatives.

Title: EFCC converts recovered university to federal institution — Chairman | - theeagleonline.com.ng
Summary: The EFCC Chairman announced that a recovered university has been converted into a federal institution.
